_comment: The synthetic checkout probe's fixture contract — MOT-523. ONE file, read by
both the seeder (scripts/seed-checkout-probe-fixture.mjs) and the probe
itself (scripts/checkout-probe.mjs), so a price or a shipping rate cannot be
changed in the seeder and silently leave the probe asserting the old number.
THE SKU IS DEDICATED TO THE PROBE AND SHARED WITH NOTHING.
The checkout matrix (website/e2e/deployed/checkout-matrix/fixtures.json) uses
the `e2e-matrix-` namespace; this one uses `probe-`. The probe reserves and
releases one unit every ten minutes, 144 times a day — pointed at a shared
SKU it would move another suite's stock under it and produce flakes that look
exactly like an inventory bug.
WHY EVERY NUMBER HERE IS WHAT IT IS:
fulfillmentType 'both'   — the probe's middle step is a re-price, and only
a product offering both shapes can actually be re-priced. A pickup-only
SKU would accept the PATCH, collapse back to pickup, return the same
total, and let a broken re-price path pass forever.
freeShippingMinItems 999 — NOT a real policy. It pins the arithmetic: the
field is otherwise inherited from the org, so a seller changing the demo
org's free-shipping threshold to 1 would waive the probe's shipping
charge and fail the total assertion with nothing actually broken.
priceCents 299 / shippingPriceCents 499 — mutually distinct, and distinct
from their sum (798), so a wrong total can only have come from the
intended mistake rather than from a coincidence of equal numbers.
stock 100000 — the probe returns its unit on every cancel, so this only
has to absorb the runs whose cancel FAILED. Those are released by the
expiry sweep within 15 minutes anyway; the headroom is so that a bad day
can never turn a monitoring outage into an out-of-stock storefront.
The name is shouted rather than subtle because this product is PUBLISHED on a
real storefront a human can browse — publishing is what makes it purchasable,
and the probe buys through the same public path a buyer does.

product.name: PROBE — do not buy
product.description: Automated checkout monitor. This is not a real product: an order is created and cancelled against it every ten minutes to prove checkout still works. Please do not buy it.
product.pickupLocation: Not a real pickup — automated checkout monitor
